A community ignores repeated warnings to change its harmful behavior, resulting in a long period of forced exile and loss of freedom as punishment for their refusal to listen.
People are facing inevitable and overwhelming disaster that causes them to lose control and suffer consequences they cannot escape.
Leaders are facing total collapse and destruction while trying to escape an overwhelming force that has ruined their livelihoods and safety.

items.h: A Warning to the Cities of Judah
items.s: People are being warned that their refusal to change their harmful behavior will lead to severe consequences and destruction of their community.
A person faces severe punishment and threats of execution for speaking unpopular truths that challenge the established authorities.

A group of people are facing severe punishment for speaking uncomfortable truths, but others intervene to save them by pointing out that previous leaders who listened to similar warnings were spared from disaster.
A person speaking truth faces violent opposition from powerful leaders who hunt them down across borders to silence them, while a friend intervenes to save their life.
People are being pressured to submit to a dominant power while others promise resistance and hope for an imminent reversal of fortune.
People are being misled by optimistic promises of quick relief from oppression, while ignoring the harsh reality of prolonged suffering and control.
People who have been forcibly removed from their homes are being advised to build a new life in a foreign land while waiting for a promised return.
People are being misled by self-appointed leaders who claim to speak for authority while spreading false hope and discouraging others from speaking out against deception.

items.h: The Restoration of Israel and Judah
items.s: People are experiencing intense panic and despair due to severe suffering and betrayal by those they trusted, yet they are being assured of eventual healing and deliverance from their oppressors.
People who have suffered loss and deep sorrow are promised that their pain will be transformed into lasting happiness and comfort.

People are experiencing a profound shift from feeling burdened by past mistakes and generational patterns to receiving unconditional acceptance and internal transformation that restores their sense of security and belonging.
A person makes a significant financial commitment to secure property rights while imprisoned in a city under siege, acting on a directive that promises future restoration despite current despair.
A person feels confused and distressed because they are being asked to make a long-term commitment or investment in a situation that appears hopeless and doomed to fail.
A community faces imminent destruction and loss due to their persistent rejection of guidance and engagement in harmful practices that have alienated their leaders.
People facing total loss and despair over their future are being assured that their current devastation will be reversed and they will eventually recover and thrive again.

items.h: The Excellence of the Restored Nation
items.s: People are trapped in a hopeless situation where their surroundings have been destroyed and they feel abandoned, yet they are called to seek answers for restoration and healing.
People feel abandoned by those in power and question whether their future and stability are truly secure despite current hardships.
A leader faces inevitable defeat by an overwhelming military force while awaiting capture and death, yet receives a promise of a peaceful end rather than a violent one.
People make a solemn promise to grant freedom to those they have enslaved, but then break that vow by forcing them back into servitude.
People are being asked to abandon their strict lifestyle rules and traditions in favor of immediate comfort or convenience.
People are being confronted for ignoring repeated warnings and advice while showing more loyalty to their own traditions than to the guidance they have been given.

items.h: Jeremiah’s Scroll Read in the Temple
items.s: A messenger is unable to deliver a critical warning directly to the public, so he delegates the task of reading the message aloud in a crowded gathering to ensure everyone hears the call for change.

items.h: Jeremiah’s Scroll Read in the Palace
items.s: People in power hear disturbing news from a subordinate and realize they must decide whether to report it to their leader despite the personal danger involved.
A leader destroys important written warnings despite being urged to preserve them, while those who delivered the message are forced into hiding.
A leader destroys written records of warnings to avoid facing consequences, prompting the author to recreate the message and announce severe repercussions for the destruction.
People are desperate for help during a crisis but refuse to accept the difficult truth that their current relief is temporary and the danger will return.
An innocent person is falsely accused, imprisoned, and mistreated by authorities despite pleading their case to a leader who eventually grants them slightly better but still confined conditions.
A messenger of truth is imprisoned by authorities who fear his message will cause panic, but a sympathetic official risks his own safety to rescue him from a life-threatening pit.

A powerful enemy surrounds a city, breaching its defenses, capturing its leader, executing his family and nobles, destroying the homes and walls, and forcing the survivors into exile while leaving behind only the destitute.
A person who has shown loyalty to others during a time of crisis receives protection and assurance of survival when everyone else is facing destruction.

A person who has survived a catastrophic event and been freed from captivity must decide whether to follow a powerful leader into exile or remain in the devastated homeland under a new local administrator.

Leaders of a defeated group seek out the appointed local administrator to negotiate their safety and future under foreign occupation, prompting displaced survivors to return home and rebuild their lives.
Leaders warn a trusted official about a hidden assassin, but he dismisses their concerns and refuses to act on the intelligence.
A trusted leader is assassinated by a former ally who then deceives and murders travelers seeking refuge before taking the remaining survivors captive.
People who have been held against their will are rescued by allies and flee to a new location to escape the threat of violent retaliation from those responsible for recent atrocities.

items.h: A Warning against Going to Egypt
items.s: People facing uncertainty after a crisis seek guidance on whether to stay in their current location or flee to another place for safety.
People ignore clear warnings about safety and choose to flee to a new place out of arrogance and fear, leading to inevitable disaster.

items.h: Judgment on the Jews in Egypt
items.s: People who have fled to a foreign land are ignoring repeated warnings and continuing harmful habits despite facing severe consequences and loss.
People persist in their familiar rituals despite warnings that these actions are causing their suffering and decline.
People persist in their chosen rituals despite warnings that these actions are leading to their destruction and exile.
A person feels exhausted by ongoing suffering and loss of peace, yet receives guidance to abandon ambitions for personal success in favor of simple survival during a time of widespread destruction.
People face overwhelming defeat and panic as their powerful defenses crumble against an unstoppable force, leaving them with no hope of escape or healing.
People are facing an overwhelming and unstoppable force that brings sudden destruction, causing widespread panic and helplessness as they watch their community fall apart.
A community faces total devastation and loss of security due to their misplaced confidence in their own strength and resources.
A powerful group that relied on its wealth and security faces sudden destruction, exile, and loss of status due to their arrogance and misplaced trust in material possessions.
People who relied on their strength and secrecy are suddenly exposed to overwhelming force and face total destruction despite their attempts to hide.
People are overwhelmed by sudden panic and helplessness as they face an unstoppable threat that destroys their defenses and silences their strength.
People living in security are suddenly targeted by a powerful enemy who plans to destroy their homes, steal their possessions, and force them into a desperate flight for survival.
A powerful group faces total defeat and forced dispersal by invading forces from all directions, yet eventually experiences a return to their homeland.
A powerful entity that once seemed invincible has been defeated and humiliated by an invading force from another direction, leaving its territory empty and ruined.
People who have been led astray by poor leadership are lost and vulnerable to exploitation, but they begin to seek a way back home and find hope in the defeat of their oppressors.
Those who celebrate their success in exploiting others will face total humiliation and destruction as justice catches up to them.
People who have been scattered and oppressed by powerful forces are seeking restoration and assurance that their past wrongs will be completely forgiven so they can find peace again.
A powerful entity faces total collapse and violent retribution for its past arrogance and cruelty, resulting in widespread devastation and loss of life.
A powerful entity that once controlled others faces sudden collapse and inevitable destruction, forcing its former victims to flee for their lives while celebrating the end of their oppression.

items.h: Praise to the God of Jacob
items.s: People feel overwhelmed by the vast power of nature and realize that their own efforts to create meaning or security through material objects are ultimately futile and empty.
A powerful oppressor who has devastated communities and exploited resources is suddenly overthrown, facing total destruction and loss of power as enemies converge to dismantle their stronghold.
A person carries out a symbolic act to ensure that a powerful enemy's downfall is remembered and sealed as permanent.
A leader faces total defeat, losing his family, his freedom, and his sight after a prolonged siege leaves his people starving and his army scattered.

A powerful force systematically dismantles a community's central gathering place and home, stripping it of all valuable materials while forcing many residents into exile and leaving behind only the destitute to survive.
Leaders and ordinary citizens are forcibly removed from their homes by military forces and executed in a foreign land, resulting in mass displacement.
A person who has been imprisoned for many years is unexpectedly pardoned, treated with kindness, and provided for daily by a ruler.

A once prosperous community has been devastated by conflict, leaving its members isolated, impoverished, and betrayed by those they trusted, while they desperately seek comfort and divine attention amidst their profound suffering.

A community suffers total devastation, loss of leadership, and starvation, leaving its members in silent despair and profound mourning over the destruction of their home and the death of their children.
A person feels completely overwhelmed by relentless suffering, isolation, and despair, believing that all hope and help have been lost.
A person endures deep suffering and humiliation while finding strength to hope in enduring kindness that renews daily.
A person endures severe persecution and despair while crying out for divine intervention against unjust enemies who have caused them immense suffering and isolation.
People are suffering from extreme starvation and loss of status, watching their loved ones die while being rejected by society and abandoned by those who promised protection.
People are experiencing total loss of property, freedom, and dignity while suffering from hunger, exhaustion, and violence without any hope of rescue.

items.h: Ezekiel’s Vision by the River Kebar
items.s: A person in exile experiences a sudden, overwhelming spiritual encounter that brings divine presence into their life during a time of forced displacement.
People witness overwhelming, chaotic forces of change that are both terrifying and awe-inspiring, requiring them to remain steadfast and responsive amidst sudden shifts in their environment.
Feeling completely overwhelmed by chaotic circumstances and needing to trust that you are being guided exactly where you need to go without having to figure out the direction yourself.
A person witnesses an overwhelming, terrifying display of power and light that induces awe and causes them to collapse in reverence.
A person feels overwhelmed by hostility and intimidation while attempting to deliver an unwelcome message to a resistant audience.
A person receives a difficult message they must deliver to an audience that is resistant and hostile, requiring them to remain steadfast despite feeling overwhelmed and isolated.
A person feels compelled to deliver difficult warnings to others despite facing severe consequences for speaking out or remaining silent.
A person is forced to perform a prolonged, physically restrictive symbolic act to demonstrate impending destruction and bear the burden of others' mistakes for an extended period.
People are forced to survive on meager, contaminated rations while enduring severe scarcity and degradation in a foreign land.
People face severe punishment and devastation for their persistent disobedience to established rules, resulting in widespread suffering and loss.
People face total devastation through starvation, violence, and forced exile as a consequence of their actions.
People face the destruction of their cherished symbols and places by an overwhelming force that leaves them helpless and devastated.
People who have survived a devastating catastrophe while being scattered among strangers begin to deeply regret their past mistakes and recognize the consequences of their actions.
People are facing an unavoidable, catastrophic collapse of their world where panic replaces joy and all hope for recovery or escape is extinguished by impending judgment.
People face total collapse where their resources are useless, their leaders are powerless, and they are left alone in terror with no hope for rescue or guidance.

items.h: The Vision of Idolatry in the Temple
items.s: A person witnesses hidden acts of betrayal and hypocrisy within their own community that are driven by a belief that no one is watching or caring about their actions.
People are being targeted for destruction based on their actions, while others are spared because they show remorse over the corruption around them.
A person witnesses a powerful force withdrawing from their home, leaving behind destruction and a profound sense of abandonment.
People in power falsely believe they are safe from impending disaster while actively causing harm to others around them.
People who have been forced to leave their homes feel abandoned and hopeless, yet are promised a future return and inner renewal.
People witness the departure of the presence that once protected their home and are transported away from their community to a foreign land where they must recount what they have seen.
A person performs strange, public acts of packing and fleeing to warn others that a forced removal from their home is imminent, while the community remains stubbornly indifferent to the warning.
People are losing hope because their expectations are not being met on time, leading them to dismiss future promises as empty or irrelevant.
People are being misled by others who offer false comfort and unwarranted optimism to hide serious underlying problems that are about to collapse.
People are being misled by those who offer comforting but deceptive promises in exchange for money, causing harm to others while protecting themselves.
People who are deeply attached to their own beliefs or desires come seeking guidance while secretly holding onto those very attachments that cause them harm.
People are facing overwhelming disasters that threaten to destroy their community and family, yet they find hope in the survival of a few who remain faithful amidst the ruin.
People who believed they were special or essential are realizing they have failed to provide any real value and are now facing total destruction due to their own unfaithfulness.
Someone who was abandoned and despised receives immense care, beauty, and status from another person, but then squanders that love by seeking validation from strangers and betraying their trust.
A person faces severe consequences and public humiliation for their past reckless behavior and broken trust, resulting in the loss of their possessions and status.
A person faces severe consequences for breaking a serious promise but is unexpectedly offered restoration and forgiveness that restores their dignity and relationship with the one they wronged.

items.h: The Parable of Two Eagles and a Vine
items.s: People who have switched their loyalty to a new protector after being abandoned by their original ally are facing the consequences of that broken trust and the resulting instability.
People are facing severe consequences for breaking promises and seeking help from unreliable sources instead of honoring their commitments.

items.h: The Soul Who Sins Will Die
items.s: People are struggling with the unfairness of generational consequences, feeling trapped by the mistakes of their ancestors while trying to break the cycle through their own choices.

items.h: A Lament for the Princes of Israel
items.s: A powerful leader falls from grace and is captured by enemies, leaving their family devastated and stripped of all influence and hope.
People who have been rescued from a difficult situation cling to their old harmful habits despite being told to let them go.

People repeatedly ignore clear guidance and break established agreements despite being given opportunities to change, leading to severe consequences that are ultimately withheld out of compassion for a larger reputation.
People are repeating the destructive habits of their ancestors by adopting harmful external rituals to cope with anxiety while ignoring the root causes of their suffering.
People who have strayed from their values are brought back through strict discipline to purify their community and restore their commitment to shared principles.

A person feels overwhelmed by an unstoppable force of destruction that threatens everything they hold dear, leaving them feeling powerless and misunderstood when they try to explain the severity of the crisis.
People are facing an unavoidable, catastrophic threat that brings intense anxiety and helplessness as they witness impending destruction.
A community suffers from systemic corruption where leaders exploit the vulnerable, break social bonds, and prioritize greed over ethical conduct, leading to inevitable collapse and public shame.
Feeling like your flaws are being exposed and intensified by intense pressure until you are forced to confront your true nature.
Leaders exploit the vulnerable for personal gain while those meant to uphold justice remain silent or complicit, leaving no one to intervene against the widespread corruption and suffering.
People abandon their original commitments to pursue powerful but ultimately destructive alliances, leading to exploitation and loss of dignity.
You face severe consequences and public humiliation because your past betrayals and reckless choices have turned former allies into enemies who strip you of everything you value.

People who have betrayed their commitments by pursuing forbidden relationships and ignoring moral boundaries face severe public punishment and loss of everything they hold dear as a consequence of their actions.

items.h: The Parable of the Cooking Pot
items.s: A community faces inevitable destruction despite repeated attempts to cleanse itself of its corruption, realizing that judgment will proceed without mercy until the consequences are fully realized.
A person is commanded to suppress their natural grief and public mourning after losing a loved one, serving as a silent symbol of impending disaster for their community.
People are mocking others who have suffered a devastating loss, celebrating their downfall with contemptuous joy.
People who feel superior because they believe their neighbors are weak and vulnerable decide to take advantage of that weakness by seizing their land and erasing their identity.
People who have suffered from the cruel retaliation of others are witnessing those same perpetrators face severe consequences for their actions.
People feel targeted by enemies who harbor deep-seated hatred and seek to destroy them out of ancient grudges.
A powerful entity that celebrated another's collapse faces imminent destruction by overwhelming forces, resulting in total loss of wealth, status, and security.
A powerful entity built to perfection collapses due to hubris, causing widespread economic ruin and mourning among those who relied on its prosperity.

items.h: A Prophecy against the Ruler of Tyre
items.s: A powerful leader becomes arrogant due to their success and wealth, only to face sudden destruction by enemies who strip them of their status and life.

items.h: A Lament for the King of Tyre
items.s: A person who once possessed exceptional talent, status, and success becomes consumed by arrogance and unethical behavior, leading to their sudden downfall and public disgrace.
People are facing violent attacks and oppression from their neighbors who treat them with contempt, but they eventually see justice served against their oppressors.
People who have been scattered from their home are promised a return to safety where they can rebuild their lives without fear of attack.
A powerful leader who claims absolute control over their resources is humiliated and destroyed, while those who relied on them for support suffer from that broken trust.

A powerful entity faces total destruction and exile due to its arrogance, resulting in long-term ruin followed by a slow, humbling restoration that prevents it from ever regaining its former dominance.
A leader exhausts resources fighting a stubborn enemy without compensation, only to receive an unexpected windfall that serves as payment for their efforts.
A powerful entity faces total destruction by invading forces, resulting in widespread death, loss of wealth, and national humiliation.
A powerful leader who relied on their own strength suffers a humiliating defeat and loses control to a stronger rival, leaving them helpless and scattered.
A powerful entity that once provided protection and prosperity for many collapses due to its own arrogance, leaving everyone who relied on it exposed and abandoned.

items.h: A Lament for Pharaoh King of Egypt
items.s: A powerful figure who once instilled terror in others faces total humiliation, defeat, and public degradation at the hands of overwhelming forces.
People who once held power and instilled fear are now facing total defeat, humiliation, and oblivion alongside their former rivals.

A person responsible for warning others of impending danger fails to do so, resulting in harm that they are held accountable for, while those who ignore the warning bear responsibility for their own fate.
People feel overwhelmed by their past mistakes and fear that they are beyond redemption, while others wrongly assume that moral standing is permanent regardless of current actions.
People cling to entitlement despite their destructive behavior, while others listen to warnings with curiosity but refuse to change their ways.
People who are supposed to care for others are exploiting them for personal gain while neglecting their needs, leaving the vulnerable scattered and unprotected.
People who have been scattered and lost are being actively sought out, rescued, and cared for by a compassionate leader who protects them from bullies and ensures they have enough to eat.
People are exhausted from constant threats and scarcity, longing for a time when they can live without fear of violence or starvation in their own homes.
You are facing severe consequences for your past hatred and desire to take what belongs to others while they were vulnerable.

items.h: A Prophecy to the Mountains of Israel
items.s: A community that has been devastated and mocked by outsiders is promised restoration, return, and prosperity after a period of desolation.

items.h: A New Heart and a New Spirit
items.s: People who have caused harm to their community are exiled and scattered, yet they are promised a complete internal transformation that restores their ability to live rightly and brings them back to their home.
Feeling completely drained and hopeless in a situation that seems dead and beyond repair, yet receiving the power to restore life and hope.
People who have been separated and scattered are being brought back together to live as a unified community under a single leader in their own home.
People living in safety and security are targeted by powerful forces seeking to steal their wealth and destroy their peace.
People who have survived a massive invasion are left to clean up the overwhelming aftermath of destruction and death in their land.
People who have been punished for their mistakes are eventually brought back to their home, forgiven, and restored to a safe life without fear.

items.h: The Man with a Measuring Rod
items.s: A person is taken to a high place to observe detailed measurements of a new structure and instructed to record everything they see for others to understand.
A person carefully measures and documents the precise dimensions of a large, complex structure to ensure its accuracy and completeness.
People are navigating through a structured, transitional space that separates them from a more restricted inner area, observing the boundaries and layout of their current environment.
People are carefully measuring and constructing a large entranceway to ensure its dimensions match previous standards.
People are navigating through structured pathways and measuring distances to understand the layout of their environment.

items.h: The Gates of the Inner Court
items.s: Navigating through identical, structured entry points to reach a secure inner space after ascending steps from each direction.
People organize their workspaces with specific areas and tools to process materials efficiently and maintain order during a demanding routine.
People who have earned special trust are assigned specific roles in dedicated spaces to serve those in charge of critical duties.
A person carefully measures and inspects a newly constructed space to ensure every dimension meets the required standards before proceeding.
A person observes detailed measurements of a sacred structure to understand its layout and significance.
People are carefully measuring and documenting the dimensions of a complex structure to ensure its precise construction and spatial organization.
A person observes intricate, repetitive details in their surroundings, finding comfort in the precise order and craftsmanship of a structured environment amidst chaos.
People are navigating strict protocols for handling specialized items to ensure they do not contaminate the general public space.
Feeling overwhelmed by chaos and lacking clear boundaries, one seeks definitive limits to distinguish what is sacred from what is ordinary in order to find stability and safety.

items.h: The Glory of the LORD Returns to the Temple
items.s: People feel abandoned by their leaders due to past failures but are offered a clear path to restore trust and establish lasting stability through strict adherence to new standards.
People are undergoing a rigorous, multi-day process of purification and restoration to prepare a central focal point for future communal gatherings and offerings.

items.h: The East Gate Assigned to the Prince
items.s: A person feels shut out from a place of power or truth that has been permanently closed to everyone except one specific individual who holds exclusive access.
People who failed to uphold their responsibilities are being demoted to lesser roles as a consequence of their past negligence and corruption.
Individuals in positions of authority must maintain strict personal boundaries and professional standards to preserve their integrity while serving others.
People are dividing up territory to ensure that essential resources and living spaces are allocated fairly for those who serve specific roles and for the general community.
People are suffering from the abuse of power by those in authority who seize resources that rightfully belong to others.
People are being cheated by dishonest weights and measures in trade, leading to unfair transactions and exploitation.
A community establishes strict rules for regular contributions of food and resources to support leadership and maintain social order during designated times of gathering.
A leader provides resources for communal gatherings while adhering to strict rules about movement and timing to ensure order and participation.

items.h: The Courts for Boiling and Baking
items.s: People are performing necessary tasks in designated areas to prevent contamination of shared spaces.
People feel stuck in a barren or stagnant situation and long for a transformative force that brings life, healing, and abundance to their surroundings.
People are receiving clear instructions on how to fairly divide territory among themselves and newcomers who have settled in their community.
People are dividing up land and resources among different groups to ensure everyone receives their designated share of territory.

items.h: The Portions for the Priests and Levites
items.s: Those responsible for maintaining order and standards are granted secure resources to fulfill their duties without fear of losing their livelihood.

People are navigating a shared community space where residential areas, agricultural land, and communal resources are carefully defined to ensure everyone has what they need to live and work together.

People are navigating complex boundaries to ensure that essential resources and central institutions remain accessible and protected for everyone while allowing leaders to manage the surrounding areas effectively.

items.h: The Portions for the Remaining Tribes
items.s: People are receiving their designated shares of land after a period of transition to ensure everyone has a place to live.
People are navigating a structured environment defined by clear boundaries and designated entry points, seeking a sense of stability and belonging within a vast, ordered system.
Young people from a conquered nation are forcibly relocated, stripped of their identities, and subjected to intensive re-education in the culture of their captors.
People resist pressure to compromise their personal values by proposing a temporary trial to prove that an alternative approach yields better results without causing harm.
Individuals demonstrate exceptional competence and insight in their field, surpassing established experts to gain recognition and secure a position of trust.
A person faces an impossible demand from a powerful authority figure who threatens severe punishment for failure to meet an unreasonable expectation.
Facing imminent execution for failing to solve an impossible problem, a group seeks divine intervention through prayer and receives unexpected insight.
A person faces an impossible challenge under threat of severe punishment and discovers that insight comes from a higher source rather than human expertise alone.
A person successfully solves an impossible problem that stumped everyone else, leading to immediate recognition, wealth, and a significant promotion in their career.
People are forced to publicly conform to a mandatory ritual under threat of severe punishment for non-compliance.
People face an ultimatum to abandon their core convictions under threat of severe punishment from those in power.

People face extreme persecution and life-threatening danger for refusing to compromise their core beliefs, yet they are miraculously protected from harm while their oppressors witness divine intervention.
A leader who has experienced a profound personal crisis now publicly acknowledges the enduring power of a higher authority to encourage others facing similar trials.

items.h: Nebuchadnezzar’s Dream of a Great Tree
items.s: A powerful leader experiences terrifying visions while resting in comfort, prompting them to seek answers from experts who fail to provide clarity.
A powerful leader receives a warning that their authority will be stripped away due to arrogance, prompting advice to show compassion and humility to restore stability.

A powerful leader becomes arrogant about their achievements and is suddenly humiliated by losing their status, sanity, and dignity, forced to live like an animal until they realize their power was never truly theirs.
A person who lost their mind and status due to arrogance regains their sanity and position after acknowledging a higher power's control over all things.
People indulge in excessive revelry and publicly honor material idols while disregarding sacred traditions or boundaries.
A leader faces an inexplicable crisis that their experts cannot solve, causing panic until someone suggests consulting a wise person from the past who has the ability to interpret the unknown.
A leader faces an impossible crisis that experts cannot solve and must rely on an outsider to reveal a fatal truth about their own arrogance and impending downfall.
A person of exceptional integrity faces coordinated efforts by jealous colleagues to fabricate charges against them using rigid rules that cannot be altered.

A person remains faithful to their private convictions despite facing severe legal penalties and betrayal by others, while an authority figure struggles between enforcing unjust laws and saving an innocent life.
A powerful leader publicly acknowledges the help received from a higher power after witnessing a miraculous rescue, declaring that this power is eternal and sovereign over all nations.

items.h: Daniel’s Vision of the Four Beasts
items.s: A person lies awake at night, overwhelmed by disturbing visions of chaotic forces rising from turmoil and terrifying powers that seem unstoppable yet are ultimately subject to a higher judgment.

items.h: Daniel’s Vision of the Ancient of Days
items.s: People feel overwhelmed by powerful forces that seem to act with arrogance and impunity, creating a sense of helplessness as they wait for justice to be served against those who have caused harm.

items.h: Daniel’s Vision of the Son of Man
items.s: People feel overwhelmed by oppressive powers and long for a decisive intervention that establishes lasting justice and peace.

A person feels deeply disturbed by terrifying visions of future chaos and oppression, seeking clarity from a wise source to understand how justice will ultimately prevail against powerful adversaries.

items.h: Daniel’s Vision of the Ram and the Goat
items.s: A person witnesses terrifying visions of powerful forces rising and falling, facing oppression and the desecration of their sacred values, while waiting for a promised restoration that seems distant.
A person seeks clarity about confusing future events and receives a detailed explanation of coming conflicts and powerful figures that are difficult to comprehend.
People facing severe consequences for past mistakes turn to higher powers with humility and fasting to seek forgiveness and relief from their suffering.

items.h: Gabriel’s Prophecy of the Seventy Weeks
items.s: A person prays for guidance during a time of crisis and receives a detailed, complex revelation about future events that seem overwhelming and difficult to understand.

A person undergoes a period of intense physical and emotional exhaustion while seeking clarity during a time of great turmoil, eventually receiving reassurance that their persistent efforts have been acknowledged despite unseen obstacles.

items.h: Kings of the South and North
items.s: People are caught in a relentless cycle of shifting alliances, broken promises, and violent conflicts between powerful groups that leave them vulnerable to betrayal and uncertainty.

A powerful leader becomes arrogant, worships wealth and military strength instead of traditional values, expands their empire through force, faces threats from multiple directions, and ultimately meets a sudden end while isolated and unsupported.
People are enduring an unprecedented period of severe crisis and uncertainty while waiting for a final resolution that will bring justice and restoration to those who remain steadfast.
A person is forced to live out their partner's infidelity through the naming of their children as a public declaration of broken trust and impending loss.

A person who has abandoned their supportive partner to chase after others for material comfort finds themselves isolated, deprived of resources, and realizing they have lost their way back to stability.
A person who has been pushed away and feels unwanted is being gently drawn back into a relationship through patient care and unconditional acceptance.

A person is commanded to restore a relationship with a partner who has been unfaithful, requiring them to pay a price and establish strict boundaries for future conduct while enduring a period of separation and uncertainty before eventual restoration.
People are trapped in a cycle of destructive habits and empty pursuits that leave them unsatisfied and disconnected from reality.

People who have broken their commitments and lost their way try to fix their problems by seeking help from powerful outsiders, only to find that those solutions fail and they must face the consequences of their own actions before they can truly heal.

items.h: The Unrepentance of Israel and Judah
items.s: People promise to fix their broken relationship after causing harm, but their commitment quickly fades like morning dew when tested by harsh truth and consequences.
People hide their wrongdoings from authority while secretly plotting against those who should protect them, leading to their own downfall and loss of strength.
People claim loyalty while secretly building false dependencies and ignoring established rules, leading to inevitable collapse and loss of control.
You are facing severe consequences for your past actions, resulting in loss of stability, resources, and community support while being rejected by those you trusted.
People who have relied on their own success and power to build systems of control are facing sudden collapse and loss because their foundations were built on deception and self-reliance.

items.h: Out of Egypt I Called My Son
items.s: People who have been cared for and guided turn away from their benefactors to pursue harmful distractions, leading to self-inflicted consequences despite being offered forgiveness.
A powerful authority struggles to enforce strict punishment on those who have deceived them because their deep affection overrides their desire for retribution.

items.h: A Reproof of Ephraim, Judah, and Jacob
items.s: People deceive others to gain wealth and power while ignoring their own moral failures and the consequences of their actions.
People abandon their core values for temporary comforts, become arrogant in their success, and face severe consequences that strip them of their stability and security.
People face total collapse because they trusted in their own leaders who failed them, yet they are promised a future victory over death and despair.
A person who appears successful and secure suddenly faces total ruin and violent destruction through no fault of their own.
People realize their past mistakes and broken relationships have led to failure, so they decide to abandon their failed coping mechanisms and sincerely ask for forgiveness and a fresh start.
People who have strayed from their values seek healing and restoration after realizing that past attachments no longer serve them.
A community faces total devastation from an overwhelming force that systematically destroys their livelihoods and resources layer by layer, leaving them with nothing but the need to mourn their loss.
People are experiencing profound loss and despair due to the destruction of their livelihoods and the failure of essential resources that sustain their daily lives.
A community faces total agricultural collapse and famine, forcing them to mourn their loss of sustenance and call for urgent intervention.
People are facing an overwhelming, unstoppable force that brings total destruction and terror to their community.
People are experiencing deep sorrow and regret over their mistakes, seeking to sincerely change their ways and restore a broken relationship through humble, collective acts of remorse.
People who have suffered severe loss and devastation are experiencing a sudden turnaround where their needs are fully met and they are restored to dignity and safety.

items.h: I Will Pour Out My Spirit
items.s: People are experiencing profound upheaval and uncertainty in their world, yet they find hope by reaching out for help during times of crisis.
People who have been oppressed and exploited by powerful groups are witnessing a decisive confrontation where justice is served against their oppressors.
People who have suffered violence and oppression are waiting for justice to be served while anticipating a future of lasting safety and abundant prosperity in their homeland.
People are facing severe consequences for their violent actions against others and breaking bonds of trust.

items.h: Judgment on Moab, Judah, and Israel
items.s: Those in power exploit the vulnerable for personal gain while ignoring moral laws, leading to inevitable collapse where no amount of strength or speed can save anyone from disaster.
People are facing severe consequences for their oppressive behavior and injustice toward others.
People who exploit others for their own comfort continue to ignore repeated warnings and sufferings, remaining stubbornly unrepentant despite facing loss and disaster.
A community suffers catastrophic loss and devastation, leaving survivors to face total abandonment and despair without hope of recovery.
People are ignoring moral integrity and exploiting the vulnerable for personal gain while clinging to empty rituals instead of addressing their harmful actions.
People perform empty rituals to hide their lack of compassion while facing inevitable disaster despite their desperate attempts to avoid it.

items.h: Woe to Those at Ease in Zion
items.s: People who are comfortable and distracted by luxury ignore the serious problems affecting their community until they face severe consequences themselves.
People who are arrogant and confident in their own power face sudden, total destruction and loss of everything they hold dear.

items.h: The Locusts, Fire, and Plumb Line
items.s: Facing repeated threats of total destruction, one pleads for mercy until a final warning signals that the time for intervention has passed and judgment is now inevitable.
A person speaking truth to power faces threats and expulsion from their community by those in authority who wish to silence them.

People are exploiting the vulnerable for financial gain while ignoring moral boundaries, leading to a sudden collapse of their security and a profound spiritual emptiness that cannot be filled by material means.
People are facing inescapable consequences for their actions despite trying to hide or flee from them.
People who have lost everything are waiting for a time when their losses will be reversed and they will finally enjoy lasting security and abundance in their own home.
You are facing total collapse because your allies have betrayed you and you previously stood by while others destroyed your loved ones without offering help.
People who have caused harm to others are finally experiencing the same consequences they inflicted on their victims, while those who were oppressed find safety and reclaim what was lost.
A person receives a clear directive to confront a powerful entity but chooses to run away instead.
People are trapped in a sudden, life-threatening crisis caused by their own hidden actions and are desperately searching for the source of their trouble.
People facing a dangerous crisis caused by their own actions must make a difficult sacrifice to restore safety and peace.
Feeling trapped in an overwhelming crisis where escape seems impossible and hope appears lost, yet finding the strength to call out for help and give thanks when rescued.
A community facing imminent destruction responds to a warning by collectively abandoning their harmful behaviors and pleading for mercy, resulting in their deliverance.

items.h: Jonah’s Anger at the LORD’s Compassion
items.s: A person feels intense resentment toward a higher power for showing mercy to enemies they despise, prioritizing their own temporary comfort over the well-being of many others who deserve compassion.
People are facing the terrifying prospect of their city being destroyed and their cherished symbols of power and wealth being completely dismantled as a consequence of their own corrupt actions.
People are experiencing profound loss and devastation, expressing their despair through public displays of mourning and shame as they face inevitable defeat and exile.
People who hold power exploit others by stealing their land and homes to enrich themselves while facing inevitable ruin as a result of their greed.
People are silencing those who speak difficult truths to avoid facing the consequences of their own harmful actions against vulnerable neighbors.
People who have been scattered and isolated are being gathered back together into a large, lively group to move forward toward freedom.
Those in power exploit and destroy the vulnerable for personal gain while falsely claiming divine protection to avoid accountability.

items.h: The Mountain of the House of the LORD
items.s: People are longing for a time of universal peace where conflict ends and individuals can live securely in their own homes without fear.
People facing overwhelming opposition and displacement feel intense anguish but are promised that their current weakness will be transformed into strength to overcome their enemies.
People are facing an imminent military siege and invasion that threatens their safety and leadership, yet they hold onto hope for a future leader who will restore order and provide lasting security.
Feeling vulnerable among many others yet finding strength to overcome adversaries and remove harmful influences from your life.
People feel they have done everything required by authority yet remain unfulfilled, realizing that genuine integrity and compassion matter more than rigid rituals or excessive effort.
People are suffering from the consequences of their own dishonesty and greed, finding that their hard work yields no results and their wealth is lost to violence.
Society has collapsed into total corruption where trust is impossible, leaders are corrupt, and even family members betray one another.
A person who has suffered a setback and feels isolated by their mistakes finds strength in patiently trusting that justice will eventually be served and their reputation restored.
People feel abandoned and vulnerable in isolation, yet they are reminded of past protection and promised that their deepest failures will be completely erased and forgiven.
People are seeking comfort and hope while waiting for justice against powerful oppressors who have caused them suffering.
A powerful entity that once seemed invincible and predatory is suddenly overwhelmed by an unstoppable force, leading to its rapid collapse and the loss of all its accumulated wealth and security.
A powerful entity faces total collapse and humiliation after years of oppression, leaving its victims without comfort or hope for recovery.
People cry out for help against ongoing violence and injustice while feeling that their pleas go unheard and that corrupt systems allow the wicked to oppress the righteous without consequence.
People feel helpless and confused as they watch powerful forces sweep through their world, destroying everything in their path with terrifying speed and arrogance.
People are watching powerful forces exploit the vulnerable without consequence, leaving them to question why justice seems absent while cruelty thrives.
A person stands in quiet anticipation, waiting for clarity and justice while observing the inevitable downfall of those who rely on arrogance and greed.

People are facing the inevitable downfall of those who accumulate wealth through exploitation, violence, and deceit, realizing that their unjust gains and hollow idols cannot protect them from judgment.

A person witnesses overwhelming displays of power and chaos that induce deep terror and physical trembling, yet they resolve to remain steadfast and wait for a future resolution despite the immediate threat of invasion and distress.
Experiencing total loss of resources and livelihood while choosing to find inner strength and hope despite the devastation.
People are facing total destruction and loss because they have abandoned their core values to pursue empty distractions and false comforts.
People are facing sudden, overwhelming disaster and loss while remaining complacent and blind to the impending consequences of their actions.
People facing imminent disaster are urged to stop their harmful behavior and adopt humility to find protection from coming judgment.
People who have relied on their secure coastal location face sudden destruction and loss of their homes, leading to displacement and eventual restoration for those who remain.
People who are being mocked and threatened by their neighbors find comfort in the promise that those bullies will eventually face destruction for their arrogance.
People who have lived in arrogant security and pride are suddenly facing total destruction and becoming a cautionary tale of ruin for others to witness.
A community has become corrupt and violent, ignoring warnings and abandoning its own moral standards while those in power exploit others without consequence.

People face severe consequences for their persistent refusal to change their harmful behavior despite clear warnings, leading to a period of intense judgment and destruction that requires patience to endure.
People who have been scattered and ashamed by their past mistakes are being restored to a state of safety, humility, and honest community where they no longer fear oppression.
People who have suffered defeat and shame are being comforted by the promise that their suffering is over and they will be restored to honor and community.

items.h: A Call to Rebuild the Temple
items.s: People are neglecting their shared responsibilities to focus on their own comfort, resulting in persistent frustration and a sense that their hard work yields no lasting benefit.
Leaders and community members overcome hesitation to resume a stalled project after receiving encouragement and support from an authority figure.

items.h: The Coming Glory of God’s House
items.s: People are discouraged by the poor condition of their current efforts compared to past successes but are encouraged to persist because they will not be alone and future results will surpass the present state.
People work hard but face disappointing results and hardship because they neglected their priorities, yet they are promised future restoration when they refocus on what matters most.
Leaders feel overwhelmed by global instability and political upheaval, yet receive reassurance of their unique value and chosen status amidst the chaos.
People are facing the consequences of past mistakes and are being urged to change their behavior before it is too late.
People who have endured long periods of hardship and uncertainty are receiving reassurance that their suffering is ending and restoration is imminent.

items.h: The Vision of the Horns and the Craftsmen
items.s: People feel overwhelmed by powerful forces that have scattered their community and destroyed their hope, but they are reassured that opposing powers will be dismantled to restore their standing.

items.h: The Vision of the Measuring Line
items.s: People feel vulnerable and exposed to threats while facing uncertainty about their future security and stability.

People who have been scattered and oppressed by powerful enemies are called to escape their current location and find safety because their protection is valued by a higher power that will intervene on their behalf.

items.h: The Vision of Joshua the High Priest
items.s: A person facing severe public condemnation and shame over past mistakes is unexpectedly cleared of blame and restored to dignity by a higher authority.

items.h: The Vision of the Lampstand and Olive Trees
items.s: People feel overwhelmed by a massive task that seems impossible to complete on their own strength and need reassurance that they can succeed through inner resilience rather than external power.

items.h: The Vision of the Flying Scroll
items.s: People feel overwhelmed by the pervasive presence of dishonesty and theft in their community, fearing that hidden wrongs will inevitably lead to total destruction.

items.h: The Vision of the Woman in a Basket
items.s: People witness a symbolic removal of corruption from their community to a distant land, realizing that systemic wrongdoing is being contained and relocated rather than immediately resolved.

items.h: The Vision of the Four Chariots
items.s: People feel anxious about global instability and seek assurance that higher powers are actively monitoring and managing the situation to bring peace.
People are rebuilding their community after returning from exile, facing the monumental task of restoring their central sanctuary while navigating complex political and spiritual leadership roles.

items.h: A Call to Justice and Mercy
items.s: People perform religious rituals to seek help while ignoring the urgent need to treat vulnerable neighbors with fairness and compassion.
People who have returned to their home after a long period of hardship are facing doubt and fear because their new reality feels fragile and uncertain compared to the past suffering they endured.

People who have relied on their own strength, wealth, and cunning to feel safe are suddenly stripped of their power and resources by a superior force, leaving them terrified while those they oppressed find unexpected protection and inclusion.

People are experiencing a profound shift from oppression to liberation, marked by a sudden transition from fear to celebration as they witness the arrival of a humble leader who promises peace and restoration.

items.h: The LORD Will Save His People
items.s: People facing overwhelming odds find strength in their collective resilience and experience a profound sense of restoration and celebration after surviving a crisis.

items.h: Judah and Israel Will Be Restored
items.s: People feel lost and oppressed because their leaders have failed them, but they are promised restoration and strength after being scattered among foreign nations.

People are suffering from systemic exploitation where those in power profit from others' misery while showing no compassion, leading to a breakdown of trust and mutual destruction within the community.
People feel deeply betrayed when their trusted leader values them only for money and then abandons them to a cruel successor who exploits rather than protects them.

People are facing overwhelming odds from hostile forces surrounding them, yet they find strength in the knowledge that a powerful protector is watching over their community and will defeat their enemies.
People are overwhelmed by profound sorrow and deep regret over their past actions toward someone they have deeply hurt.
People are seeking a way to wash away their past mistakes and completely abandon the false beliefs that once controlled them, even facing severe social consequences for rejecting those old ways.

items.h: The Shepherd Struck, the Sheep Scattered
items.s: A trusted leader is removed or destroyed, causing immediate chaos and leaving individuals to face severe trials alone while hoping for eventual restoration.
People face total devastation by invading forces, experiencing loss of safety, property, and loved ones, while awaiting a sudden and overwhelming intervention that turns their despair into security.

items.h: All Nations Will Worship the King
items.s: People realize that joining together in shared rituals and respecting common spaces is essential for their collective well-being and survival.
People question whether they are truly valued by those in power who seem to favor others while treating them with hostility and destruction.
People are performing their duties with resentment and carelessness, offering inferior results while claiming the process is burdensome and worthless.
People in positions of authority are failing to uphold their duties and integrity, leading to a loss of respect and trust from those they serve.
People are breaking their marriage vows by abandoning their partners for others, which causes deep emotional pain and leads them to question why their prayers go unanswered.
People are enduring a difficult period of purification and judgment while waiting for justice to be served against those who exploit the vulnerable.
People feel they are giving less than they should to those in charge and wonder how to restore a broken relationship while seeking security and abundance.
People feel that their hard work and moral integrity are pointless because those who act selfishly seem to succeed without consequence.
People facing severe judgment for their arrogance and wrongdoing while others who remain loyal find hope, healing, and future vindication amidst a time of waiting for a major turning point.
People trace their lineage through generations to understand their identity and roots within a long historical continuum.
A person discovers an unexpected pregnancy in a relationship bound by formal commitment and must decide how to proceed when faced with a sudden, life-altering revelation.
People travel a long distance guided by a sign to find and honor someone they believe holds great significance, bringing valuable gifts while avoiding those who might cause them harm.
A family is forced to leave their home in secret at night to escape an imminent threat from a powerful ruler seeking to harm a child.
A powerful leader reacts with rage to being deceived, ordering the massacre of innocent children in a specific location.
A family escapes danger in exile but must change their plans and settle in an unfamiliar place due to new political threats.

items.h: The Mission of John the Baptist
items.s: People are seeking a way to turn away from their past mistakes and prepare themselves for an imminent, powerful change in their lives.
A person undergoes a significant public ritual to mark a new beginning, receiving validation and affirmation from a higher authority during a transformative moment.
A person faces intense pressure to compromise their core values for immediate relief or power while isolated and exhausted.
A leader retreats to a new location after hearing troubling news about an associate and begins calling for a fundamental change in how people live their lives.
People are called to abandon their familiar livelihoods and relationships to pursue an uncertain new path of purpose.
People suffering from various physical illnesses and disabilities seek out a healer who cures them, causing large crowds to gather and follow him.
A group of people gathers to listen to someone who has taken a seat to share wisdom with them.
People who feel spiritually empty, deeply sorrowful, humble, or oppressed by others are encouraged to find hope and future reward in their current struggles.
People feel ineffective or hidden when they want their positive actions to have a meaningful impact on others.
People are confused about whether their long-held rules and traditions still matter or have been replaced by new teachings.
People are struggling with deep resentment toward others and must prioritize repairing broken relationships before pursuing other important goals.

A person struggles with intense internal desires and recognizes that their private thoughts have crossed moral boundaries, leading them to seek drastic measures to stop themselves from acting on those impulses.
A person seeks to end their marriage but faces moral consequences for themselves and others involved in the new relationship.
People feel pressured to make elaborate promises or guarantees to prove their honesty, but are advised to rely on simple, direct truthfulness in their daily interactions.
People feel wronged by others and are tempted to retaliate, but they choose to respond with unexpected generosity and kindness instead of seeking revenge.
People perform charitable acts publicly to gain social approval rather than out of genuine compassion.

People feel pressured to perform their personal rituals for public approval or believe that repeating phrases endlessly will force a response from a higher power, when they could instead find peace through quiet sincerity and honest communication.
A person wants to engage in a private spiritual discipline without seeking attention or validation from others.
People worry about losing their material wealth to theft or decay and seek a more secure foundation for their values.
People struggle to maintain clarity of purpose while being pulled between competing loyalties that threaten to divide their attention and values.
People are overwhelmed by anxiety over basic survival needs like food, clothing, and financial security, fearing they cannot provide for themselves or their families in the future.
People who are quick to criticize others' minor flaws while ignoring their own significant problems, often leading to conflict when they try to correct those who do not appreciate their help.
People are facing uncertainty and need to persistently pursue answers and support from those in authority who care for them.
People are choosing between an easy, popular path that leads to ruin and a difficult, less-traveled path that leads to survival.
People are being deceived by those who appear trustworthy but act maliciously, requiring them to judge character by long-term actions rather than impressive words or deeds.
People face severe storms and challenges that test the stability of their lives based on whether they have prepared properly for adversity.
People are deeply impressed by a speaker who delivers clear, powerful guidance that resonates with genuine conviction rather than rigid tradition.
A person suffering from a visible and isolating condition approaches someone with the power to heal them, expressing both hope in their ability and uncertainty about their willingness to help.
A person in authority recognizes their own limitations and asks for help from someone they believe has greater power to solve a critical problem affecting a loved one.
A person caring for a loved one who is suddenly ill seeks relief from their suffering through direct intervention.
People make impulsive promises to join a cause without considering the hardship and lack of stability that comes with it.
People face a sudden, overwhelming crisis that threatens their safety while they feel helpless and terrified in the midst of it.
People are overwhelmed by chaotic forces that disrupt their safety and livelihood, leading them to reject the very presence that could restore order.
People bring a paralyzed friend to a healer who first addresses their inner guilt before physically restoring them, demonstrating authority over both spiritual and physical burdens.
A person in a marginalized social role is invited to leave their current life behind and join a new community, while others judge this choice as inappropriate.
People feel confused and resentful when they see others not following traditional rituals of self-denial while they themselves are struggling with discipline and sacrifice.
People attempt to force new changes into old structures that cannot accommodate them, resulting in damage to both the change and the structure.
People in desperate need of help reach out to a healer for physical restoration and the restoration of their loved ones from death.

items.s: People seek help for severe physical impairments and face skepticism from those who dismiss their experiences as illegitimate.

Individuals must choose whether to openly support a leader in public despite social pressure or risk losing their standing.
People face intense conflict and rejection from their own families because they have chosen to prioritize their personal convictions over familial loyalty.

People who are actively supporting others in their spiritual journey or helping those who follow a specific teacher, even through small acts of kindness, seek assurance that their efforts will be recognized and valued.
A person in isolation hears reports of positive changes in the world and questions whether to trust a new leader or seek another path.
People are struggling to accept a new leader because their rigid expectations prevent them from recognizing his true value regardless of how he presents himself.
People witness clear evidence of help or positive change but stubbornly refuse to alter their behavior or acknowledge the opportunity for improvement.
People who are exhausted by heavy responsibilities seek relief from their burdens through a compassionate guide.
People are forced to choose between strict adherence to rigid rules and meeting their basic physical needs.
People use rigid rules to trap someone who is trying to help others, prioritizing control over compassion.
People seek help for their suffering but fear that drawing attention to themselves will bring unwanted consequences or judgment.
People are divided by conflicting interpretations of extraordinary events, leading to accusations that undermine the source of positive change while others seek clarity amidst confusion.
A person worries that they have crossed an irreversible line by rejecting the source of their inner guidance, fearing that no future chance for redemption remains.
People are judged by their actions and words, which reveal the true state of their inner character.
People demand proof of truth while ignoring the wisdom and guidance already available to them.
People who have tried to improve their lives find themselves falling back into worse habits because they failed to fill the empty space with positive change.
A person feels overlooked by their family while focusing on their personal mission, yet finds that their true community consists of those who share their core values and purpose.

items.h: The Parable of the Sower Explained

People struggle to maintain their integrity and quality while dealing with hidden sabotage and corruption introduced by adversaries in their environment.

items.h: The Parable of the Mustard Seed
items.s: You are starting something small and seemingly insignificant, hoping it will grow into something substantial and protective over time.
You are working with limited resources to nurture something small and hidden until it transforms everything around you.

items.h: I Will Open My Mouth in Parables
items.s: People struggle to understand deep truths because they are presented in indirect stories rather than direct explanations.

items.h: The Parable of the Weeds Explained
items.s: People are confused by the coexistence of good and bad in their world and seek clarity on why evil persists alongside righteousness.

items.h: The Parables of the Treasure and the Pearl

People face the difficult task of making hard choices to separate valuable things from worthless ones after a long period of gathering everything together.

A person is forced to execute an innocent individual due to public pressure and a rash promise made in embarrassment.

People are struggling against overwhelming odds in a dangerous situation and feel terrified when they see an unexpected figure approaching them on the water.
People in distress seek out a healer and are restored to health through minimal contact.
People are being criticized for ignoring established social customs while claiming to uphold higher moral standards, revealing a contradiction between their outward behavior and inner values.
People are confused by criticism regarding their daily habits and seek clarity on what truly constitutes moral failure versus superficial rule-breaking.

items.h: The Faith of the Canaanite Woman
items.s: A desperate parent pleads for help to save their child from severe suffering despite facing initial silence and harsh rejection.

People demand undeniable proof to validate their beliefs while ignoring the clear evidence already present in their surroundings.

Witnessing an overwhelming and terrifying display of power that leaves one shaken and fearful, yet receiving gentle reassurance to stand firm.
A desperate parent brings a loved one suffering from uncontrollable seizures to a healer after previous attempts to help have failed.

A person faces an unexpected financial demand and seeks guidance on how to handle the obligation without causing unnecessary conflict.
People are competing for status and trying to determine who holds the highest rank among them.
People are causing others to fail morally and are struggling with their own destructive habits that lead to ruin.

items.h: The Parable of the Lost Sheep
items.s: Feeling insignificant or overlooked while longing for someone to actively seek you out and value your return more than those who have never left.

People navigate the difficult process of addressing interpersonal conflicts by escalating private disagreements through increasingly formal channels until a resolution is reached or the relationship ends.
Two or more people come together to seek help for a shared goal by agreeing on what they want to achieve.
A person who has been shown immense mercy by another feels unable to extend similar compassion to someone else for a much smaller offense.
People are navigating the complexities of ending a marriage and dealing with the emotional fallout of separation.
People seek comfort and blessing for their young ones from a respected figure, but are initially discouraged by others who believe they should not be disturbed.

A person who has followed all the rules feels empty and asks what more they must do to find true fulfillment, only to be told that letting go of their most valuable possessions is required, which causes them great sorrow because they are too attached to their wealth.
People who have worked long hours feel resentful when newcomers receive the same reward despite working less time.

items.h: The Third Prediction of the Passion
items.s: A leader warns close followers that they are heading toward a dangerous destination where they will face severe mistreatment and death, yet promises a return to life afterward.

People seek special recognition or power for themselves and their loved ones, leading to conflict among peers until they are taught that true leadership requires serving others rather than being served.

items.h: The Blind Men by the Road
items.s: People who are helpless and ignored by others persistently plead for help from someone passing by until they receive relief.
A leader arrives in a city to great acclaim, prompting crowds to celebrate enthusiastically while others question his identity.
A leader confronts corrupt officials who are exploiting sacred spaces for profit, restoring dignity to the marginalized while facing opposition from those in power.
A person feels their efforts are producing no results despite appearing promising on the surface, leading to frustration over a lack of tangible progress.
People in positions of power confront an individual to demand justification for their actions while secretly weighing political consequences over truth.

items.h: The Parable of the Two Sons
items.s: People make promises they do not keep while others initially refuse but ultimately follow through on their commitments.

items.s: People in positions of trust exploit those sent to collect what is owed, culminating in the murder of the owner's heir who they believe will allow them to seize control.
People are invited to a significant opportunity but ignore it for their daily routines, leading to severe consequences, while others who attend without proper preparation face punishment.
People use clever questions to trap an authority figure into making a statement that could cause them trouble with those in power.

Seeking clarity on fundamental principles to navigate complex moral dilemmas and find a unifying purpose in life.
People challenge an authority figure with a logical trap to expose a contradiction in their teachings, leaving them unable to respond and silenced by the encounter.
People who enforce strict rules on others while ignoring their own hypocrisy and failing to show compassion or justice in their daily lives.
A leader expresses deep sorrow over their inability to protect a community from destruction despite repeated attempts to offer safety and care.
People witness the collapse of their most cherished institutions and face widespread chaos, deception, and disaster while waiting for answers about the future.
People face intense hostility and persecution from society while remaining steadfast in their convictions despite widespread deception and moral decay around them.
People are fleeing for their lives from an imminent disaster, leaving everything behind to survive a period of extreme chaos and deception.

items.h: The Return of the Son of Man
items.s: People are confused by conflicting rumors and desperate signs of change, yet they must remain calm and wait for a sudden, undeniable event that will bring clarity and gather them together.

items.h: The Lesson of the Fig Tree
items.s: People are observing clear signs in their environment that indicate a significant change or event is imminent and requires them to stay alert.
People are living their daily routines without realizing that an unexpected event could change everything at any moment, requiring them to stay alert and responsible.

Individuals are judged on how they utilized the resources and opportunities entrusted to them, facing reward for diligent effort or severe consequences for letting fear prevent action.
People are judged based on whether they showed compassion to those in need without realizing their actions were significant.
Opponents secretly plot to eliminate a prominent figure while carefully avoiding public gatherings to prevent unrest among the crowd.
A person makes a generous, seemingly wasteful gesture of devotion that others criticize as impractical, yet it is recognized as a profound and necessary act of honor.
A trusted associate secretly negotiates a financial reward to hand over a close friend to authorities for personal gain.
People seek clear direction for preparing an important gathering and follow specific instructions to ensure everything is ready on time.
A group of close companions shares a final meal together while one among them secretly plans to betray the leader, causing deep sorrow and anxiety for everyone present.
People confidently promise unwavering loyalty in a crisis, only to be warned that they will fail under pressure before the day ends.
A person faces an overwhelming burden and intense anxiety while struggling to accept a difficult fate they cannot avoid.
A trusted insider uses intimacy to facilitate an ambush, leading to sudden arrest and the abandonment by close allies.

A group of people is manipulated by leaders into choosing to free a dangerous criminal while demanding the execution of an innocent person who is being unfairly pressured by authorities.
A leader facing an angry mob tries to avoid responsibility for a wrongful decision by publicly declaring they are not to blame while still allowing the harmful outcome to proceed.
A person in power is subjected to public humiliation, physical abuse, and mockery by a group of others who twist their words and actions into ridicule.
A person is being publicly humiliated and tortured while bystanders mock their suffering and demand proof of their worthiness to survive.

A person experiences profound isolation and abandonment while facing a fatal crisis, surrounded by onlookers who are confused or indifferent to their suffering until dramatic events reveal the gravity of the moment.
A person takes responsibility for the respectful care of a deceased loved one, ensuring they are laid to rest with dignity despite the circumstances.
People who fear being deceived take extreme measures to secure a location and prevent others from accessing it.
People who have lost someone dear to them experience shock and fear when they discover that the person has returned from death, leading to overwhelming joy and a new sense of purpose.
People in power spread a deliberate lie to cover up their failure and protect themselves from consequences.
A group of followers gathers at a designated location to receive final guidance from their leader before continuing their mission alone.

A person feels overwhelmed by an internal force that causes distress and loss of control, while others witness a sudden intervention that restores order and inspires awe.
People bring their loved ones who are suffering from sudden illness to someone they believe can restore health, resulting in immediate relief and a community gathering for help.

People are facing intense scrutiny and accusations of madness from their own family while being publicly blamed for supernatural powers by outsiders.

People feel overlooked by those who claim close personal ties while seeking to prioritize their broader community of shared values.
People are listening to someone share stories using everyday examples to explain complex truths about how different responses lead to vastly different results.

items.h: The Parable of the Sower Explained

People are hiding their insights or talents out of fear or modesty instead of sharing them openly for the benefit of others.

items.h: The Parable of the Mustard Seed

People facing terminal illness and chronic suffering reach out in desperation for help, while others dismiss their hope as futile.

People are sent out to help others while relying on minimal resources and facing potential rejection from those they try to assist.
A leader makes an impulsive promise to save face in front of others and is forced to carry out a cruel act despite his personal reservations because he cannot back down from his public word.

items.h: The Feeding of the Five Thousand

People who are skeptical and demanding proof before they will believe what is being presented to them.

A person who has followed all the rules their whole life realizes they are still missing something essential and must let go of their most prized possessions to find true fulfillment.

items.h: The Third Prediction of the Passion

People are gathering in large numbers to seek relief from physical illness and distress through the presence of a respected healer.
